statement: The appendices of arxiv:2609.12230 contain a preliminary threshold-selection sweep (Table 23) that varies the SapBERT similarity threshold, changing the mean number of context triples per row, and evaluates the BASE model on CG-grounded 1-hop QA by modifying only the inference prompt; it also reports final context-selection statistics (Table 24) including mean context triples before and after filtering.

evidence.quote: Table 23 reports the preliminary threshold-selection sweep used to choose the SapBERT similarity threshold θ for each disease setting.
For each candidate threshold, we retrieved the corresponding context triples and modified only the inference prompt so that the model could use the retrieved context when answering.
